extension.summary: Play movies/episodes via a personal stream-only Stremio addon (Lumio)
extension.description: Standalone player for Stremio addons that only expose a "stream" resource (no catalog), such as Lumio. Browse TMDB catalogues for movies, TV shows and anime, or search, then pick a stream to play directly, bypassing any torrent/debrid-oriented scraper pipeline. Requires a free TMDB API key.[CR][CR]This product uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.
